coverage.message: Numeric live state is active for this match. Live state webhooks are eligible while the match remains live.

definitions.schedule_metadata: A stored schedule/match row exists in Cito.
definitions.live_row: A match with live rows never reports live_row: false.
definitions.numeric_live_state: Current kills, gold, towers, objectives, player stats, or game clock are present.
definitions.webhook_event: Recent lol.live.* events for this match exist in the webhook outbox (webhook_events), or numeric live state is present and therefore eligible to emit them.
definitions.expected_live_state: True when the pipeline CAN and IS expected to produce numeric live state for THIS match now: the match is currently tracked, or it is inside its live window in a league with proven live tracking in the trailing 14 days.
definitions.expected_webhooks: True when lol.live.* webhooks are expected for THIS match now. A match that is currently tracked always reports expected_webhooks: true.
definitions.expected_reason: Machine-readable reason for the current expectation: not_started | completed | league_feed_delayed | league_not_coverable | tracking_stalled. tracking_stalled means coverage is expected but absent — alert on it.
definitions.tracking: Observed live tracking for this match: tracked_games / first_tracked_at / last_tracked_at from the live cache, plus recent_webhook_events / last_webhook_at from the webhook outbox. Diff tracked_games against the games array to spot partial coverage (e.g. a missed game 1).
definitions.live_status: Match-scoped live tracking status: live (actively tracked now) | delayed (tracked earlier, not active now) | none (never tracked) | temporarily_unavailable (pre-check failed).
definitions.postgame_enrichment: Section-by-section postgame coverage for completed games. Use availableSections and missingSections on /lol/games/{gameId}/postgame for the exact game-level contract.
definitions.recommended_rule: For production decisions, require schedule_metadata + live_row + numeric_live_state. Road of Legends). For LCK CL / Academy / unknown Tier-2, never assume live state before this pre-check confirms it. Alert when expected_webhooks is true but webhook_event stays false (expected_reason: tracking_stalled).
